news.n_eth_ascalon: Merchants from the north say the Frankish crusaders have taken the coastal city of Ascalon from the Egyptians after a long siege.
news.n_eth_idrisi: They say that far to the west, on the island of Sicily, the scholar al-Idrisi has drawn a map of the whole world for a Christian king - and even Abyssinia is on it.
news.n_eth_sanjar: Persian merchants say the great Seljuk sultan Sanjar has died, and his realm is falling apart.
news.n_eth_mahdia: Word from Egypt: in Ifriqiya the Almohad warriors have taken the city of Mahdia back from the Norman Franks.
news.n_eth_notre_dame: Pilgrims say that in Paris, a distant city of the Franks, the foundations of a huge cathedral to Our Lady have been laid.
news.n_eth_prester_letter: They say the Franks are passing round a letter from "Prester John", a mighty Christian king at the edge of the world. The monks in Jerusalem laugh: could they mean our king?
news.n_eth_fustat: Merchants from Egypt say the vizier ordered the old city of Fustat burned so it would not fall to the Franks. The fire burned for almost two months.
news.n_eth_saladin_vizier: News from Egypt: a Kurdish commander, Salah ad-Din, has become vizier to the caliph.
news.n_eth_fatimids_end: They say the Fatimid caliphs are no longer named in the Friday prayers in Cairo: Salah ad-Din has put an end to their rule.
news.n_eth_yemen_ayyubid: Merchants on the coast say Salah ad-Din's brother has conquered Yemen across the sea. The far shore has new masters.
news.n_eth_pope_letter: Monks from Jerusalem say the pope of Rome wrote a letter to "Prester John" and sent his own physician to deliver it. Whether he arrived, nobody knows.
news.n_eth_lalibela_king: They say a new king has taken the throne in Lasta - Lalibela, the one whose cradle, people tell, was swarmed by bees.
news.n_eth_ibn_jubayr: Merchants tell of a pilgrim from al-Andalus, Ibn Jubayr, who crossed Egypt and the Red Sea to Mecca and writes down everything he sees.
news.n_eth_angkor: Far to the east, they say, lies the kingdom of the Khmers, where the king builds stone temples taller than mountains.
news.n_eth_third_crusade: Merchants from the north say the kings of the Franks are gathering a huge army to win back Jerusalem.
news.n_eth_acre: News has come: the Frankish king Richard has taken the coastal fortress of Acre from Salah ad-Din.
news.n_eth_jaffa_treaty: The pilgrims rejoice: Salah ad-Din and the king of the Franks have made peace, and Christians may once again go to pray in Jerusalem.
news.n_eth_saladin_dies: They say Sultan Salah ad-Din has died in Damascus. His sons are already quarrelling over the inheritance.
news.n_eth_innocent: Pilgrims say a new pope, Innocent, has been chosen in Rome, and that he is calling the Franks to a new crusade.
news.n_eth_fourth_crusade: Merchants say the Franks gathered for a crusade, but instead of Jerusalem they went off to plunder Christian cities.
news.n_eth_constantinople_sack: Terrible news: the Franks have taken and sacked Constantinople, the great city of the Greeks.
news.n_eth_genghis: Far to the east, they say, the steppe tribes have proclaimed a great khan over themselves - Genghis.
news.n_eth_albigensian: Pilgrims say Franks are fighting Franks: the pope has declared a crusade against heretics in the south of their lands.
news.n_eth_las_navas: Merchants from the west report that in al-Andalus the Christian kings have routed the Almohad army.
news.n_eth_lateran: They say a great council of Frankish bishops has met in Rome and decided to raise a new crusade for the Holy Land.
news.n_eth_damietta_siege: News from Egypt: the Franks have laid siege to Damietta at the mouth of the Nile.
news.n_eth_francis: The monks tell a strange tale: a Frankish monk in a plain habit, Francis, walked into the Egyptian sultan's camp to preach to him - and came back alive.
news.n_eth_damietta_lost: They say the Franks have left Egypt: the Nile flooded, their army was stuck in the mud and they had to give up Damietta.
news.n_eth_lalibela_dies: They say King Lalibela, builder of the rock churches, has died in Lasta. He will be venerated as a saint.
news.n_eth_genghis_dies: Merchants from the east say the great khan Genghis is dead, but his sons are going further still.
news.n_eth_frederick: The pilgrims are amazed: a Frankish emperor has obtained Jerusalem from the sultan by treaty, without a single battle.
news.n_eth_mongols_persia: Merchants from Persia say the Mongols have ravaged their cities and driven the craftsmen off to the distant steppes.
news.n_eth_mali: Merchants from the west tell of a new kingdom beyond the desert - Mali, ruled by Sundiata - and of the gold mined there.
news.n_eth_kiev: They say the Mongols have destroyed a great Christian city in the north - Kiev.
news.n_eth_jerusalem_sacked: Grief in Jerusalem: the city has been sacked by Khwarazmian horsemen, and many churches defiled.
news.n_eth_carpini: They say an envoy of the pope reached the Mongol khan himself and came back with a proud answer: submit.
news.n_eth_mamluks: News from Egypt: the Frankish king Louis has been captured at Mansurah, and power in Cairo has been seized by the Mamluks, the slave soldiers.
news.n_eth_louis_home: They say the Frankish king Louis, ransomed from captivity, has finally sailed home.
news.n_eth_baghdad: The Muslim merchants are in mourning: the Mongols have taken Baghdad and killed the last caliph.
news.n_eth_ain_jalut: News has come: the Egyptian Mamluks have defeated the Mongols at Ain Jalut. Their invincibility is over.
news.n_eth_baybars: Merchants say Sultan Baybars is taking one fortress after another from the Franks along the coast.
news.n_eth_antioch: They say the Mamluks have taken and destroyed ancient Antioch.
news.n_eth_louis_tunis: They say the Frankish king Louis went on crusade again - and died of sickness outside Tunis.
news.n_eth_marco_polo: They say Venetian merchants have set out across all of Asia to the court of the Mongol khan.
news.n_eth_hangzhou: Far to the east, people say, the Mongols have taken the vast capital of the Chinese.
news.n_eth_song_end: They say the last Chinese kingdom has fallen, and the Mongol khan Kublai rules all of China.
news.n_eth_kamikaze: Merchants from the east say a Mongol fleet sailing for the islands of Japan was destroyed by a terrible storm.
news.n_eth_yekuno_dies: News has come: King Yekuno Amlak has died. His son Yagbe'u Seyon has taken the throne.
news.n_eth_ifat_shewa: Merchants from the east say the sultans of Ifat have conquered the old Muslim sultanate in Shewa.
news.n_eth_tripoli: They say the Mamluks have taken the coastal city of Tripoli from the Franks.
news.n_eth_acre_falls: The Franks' last fortress by the sea, Acre, has fallen. The pilgrims say there are no more crusaders in the Holy Land.
news.n_eth_yagbeu_dies: They say King Yagbe'u Seyon has died, and his sons cannot agree on the throne.
news.n_eth_kublai_dies: Merchants from the east say the great khan Kublai died a few years ago and the Mongol realm is dividing.
news.n_eth_wedem_arad: News has come: Wedem Arad, another son of Yekuno Amlak, has become king.
news.n_eth_jubilee: Pilgrims report that the pope has declared a holy year, and crowds of pilgrims from all the Frankish lands are heading for Rome.
news.n_eth_osman: Merchants say a new Turkish bey, Osman, is gaining strength in Anatolia.
news.n_eth_france_jews: Pilgrims say the king of the Franks has expelled all the Jews from his country and seized their property.
news.n_eth_avignon: They say the pope has left Rome and now lives in the Frankish city of Avignon.
news.n_eth_mansa_musa_king: Merchants from the west say a new king, Musa, has taken the throne in Mali.
news.n_eth_amda_seyon_king: News has come: Amda Seyon has become king. They say he is young, hot-blooded and afraid of no one.
news.n_eth_great_famine: Pilgrims say that in the lands of the Franks the harvest rotted for several years running and people died of hunger.
news.n_eth_copts_cairo: Bitter news from Egypt: in Cairo a mob has destroyed many Coptic churches.
news.n_eth_mansa_musa: Merchants from Egypt tell of King Musa of Mali: he passed through Cairo on his way to Mecca and gave away so much gold that its price fell.
news.n_eth_ibn_battuta: They say a young scholar from Tangier, Ibn Battuta, has set out on the hajj - and seems in no hurry to go home.
news.n_eth_envoy_seized: They say the sultan of Ifat has seized a royal envoy on his way back from Egypt. King Amda Seyon is furious.
news.n_eth_battuta_zeila: Merchants from the coast tell of the traveller Ibn Battuta, who visited Zeila and complained about its dirt and smell of fish.
news.n_eth_amda_victory: News has come: King Amda Seyon has defeated the Muslim rulers of the east and subdued Ifat.
news.n_eth_hundred_years: They say the kings of the Franks and the English have begun a war over a crown, and there is no end in sight.
news.n_eth_ewostatewos_abroad: They say the monk Ewostatewos and his disciples have left the country, for Egypt and further still, Armenia.
news.n_eth_amda_dies: News has come: the great King Amda Seyon is dead. His son Newaya Krestos has become king.
news.n_eth_plague_alexandria: Terrible news from Egypt: a plague has come to Alexandria on the ships. People die within three days.
news.n_eth_plague_cairo: They say thousands die every day of the plague in Cairo, and the streets are empty.
news.n_eth_ewostatewos_dies: The monks say the holy Ewostatewos has died in a foreign land, in Armenia. His disciples are coming home.
news.n_eth_ming_rising: Far to the east, the merchants say, the Chinese in red turbans have risen against the Mongols.
news.n_eth_poitiers: Pilgrims say the English have defeated the Franks and captured their king himself.
news.n_eth_sultan_hasan: Merchants from Egypt say the Mamluks have killed Sultan Hasan, and his vast mosque in Cairo is still unfinished.
news.n_eth_alexandria_sack: News has come: Franks from the island of Cyprus suddenly attacked and sacked Alexandria. The sultan of Egypt is furious, and the Copts are suffering for it.
news.n_eth_ming: They say the Chinese have driven out the Mongols and put their own emperor on the throne.
news.n_eth_timur: Merchants from Persia tell of a lame warrior, Timur, who has become lord of Samarkand.
news.n_eth_newaya_maryam: News has come: Newaya Maryam has become king.
news.n_eth_papacy_rome: Pilgrims report that the pope has returned from Avignon to Rome.
news.n_eth_kulikovo: Merchants from the north say the Rus have defeated an army of the Mongol Horde for the first time.
news.n_eth_dawit_king: News has come: Dawit has become king. They say he is pious and loves books.
news.n_eth_timur_georgia: They say Timur has ravaged Christian Georgia.
news.n_eth_kosovo: They say the Turks have defeated the Serbs on the Field of Kosovo, though their sultan was killed in the battle.
news.n_eth_tarnovo: Merchants say the Turks have taken Tarnovo, capital of the Bulgarian tsardom.
news.n_eth_nicopolis: News has come: a huge army of Franks has been destroyed by the Turks at Nicopolis.
news.n_eth_delhi: Merchants from India say Timur has taken and ravaged Delhi.
news.n_eth_damascus: They say Timur has burned Damascus, and the Mamluks could not stop him.
news.n_eth_venice_envoys: They say envoys of King Dawit have been to distant Venice and brought back craftsmen and gifts.
news.n_eth_ankara: Merchants say Timur defeated the Turkish sultan Bayezid at Ankara and took him prisoner.
news.n_eth_zheng_he: Far to the east, they say, the Chinese emperor has sent to sea a fleet of hundreds of enormous ships.
news.n_eth_grunwald: Pilgrims tell of a great battle in the north where the Poles and Lithuanians defeated the knight-monks.
news.n_eth_dawit_dies: News has come: King Dawit has died - killed, they say, by a startled horse. His son Tewodros has become king.
news.n_eth_yeshaq_king: News has come: Yeshaq, another son of Dawit, has become king.
news.n_eth_sad_addin: They say Sa'd ad-Din, sultan of Ifat, was killed on an island off Zeila, and his sons fled across the sea to Yemen.
news.n_eth_chinese_fleet: Merchants from the coast tell of Chinese ships as big as mountains that called at Mogadishu, and of a giraffe taken to the Chinese emperor.
news.n_eth_constantinople_siege: They say the Turks besieged Constantinople but could not take its walls.
news.n_eth_aragon_embassy: They say King Yeshaq has sent an embassy to a distant Frankish king in Aragon, offering an alliance and a marriage between their houses.
news.n_eth_joan: Pilgrims tell of a warrior girl among the Franks who lifted a siege of one of their cities and leads their army.
news.n_eth_zara_yaqob_king: News has come: Zara Yaqob, the youngest son of Dawit, who spent years confined on a mountain, has become king.
news.n_eth_zy_crowned_news: They say King Zara Yaqob has been crowned at Aksum, like the ancient kings.
news.n_eth_florence: Monks from Jerusalem say Ethiopian brethren attended the great council of the Franks in Florence, where they spoke of church unity.
news.n_eth_varna: Merchants say the Turks have again routed a Christian army, this time at Varna.
news.n_eth_gomit_news: News has come: King Zara Yaqob has defeated the sultan of Adal at Gomit.
news.n_eth_maghtas: They say the sultan in Egypt has destroyed the Coptic monastery of al-Maghtas, where the Virgin Mary is said to have appeared. In anger, King Zara Yaqob has ordered a monastery in Shewa named in its memory.
news.n_eth_constantinople_falls: Terrible news: the Turks have taken Constantinople. The last emperor of the Greeks died on the walls.
news.n_eth_printing: Pilgrims say the Franks have learned to make books not with pens but with iron letters - dozens of identical books at once.
news.n_eth_comet: They say a tailed star burned over Shewa for several nights, and the king saw a sign in it.
news.n_eth_zy_berhan: They say King Zara Yaqob hardly leaves his palace at Debre Berhan, and few ever see his face.
news.n_eth_zy_harsh: They say King Zara Yaqob has grown very harsh: he has even his own kin flogged and exiled on suspicion of treason.
news.n_eth_zy_dies: News has come: King Zara Yaqob is dead. His son Baeda Maryam has become king, and many exiles have been recalled.
news.n_eth_portuguese_gold: Merchants from the west say the Portuguese Franks are sailing further and further south along the coasts of Africa.
news.n_eth_baeda_wars: They say King Baeda Maryam is fighting the men of Adal in the east.
news.n_eth_eskender_king: News has come: King Baeda Maryam is dead, and Eskender, a boy ruled by his courtiers, has become king.
news.n_eth_mehmed_dies: They say the Turkish sultan Mehmed, conqueror of Constantinople, has died.
news.n_eth_kongo: Merchants from the west tell of Franks who sailed to the mouth of a huge river in the kingdom of Kongo.
news.n_eth_covilha_sets_out: They say the Portuguese king has sent men overland to find "Prester John", the Christian king beyond the seas.
news.n_eth_cape: Merchants say Frankish ships have rounded the southern tip of Africa.
news.n_eth_granada: They say the Christian kings have taken Granada, the last Muslim city in al-Andalus.
news.n_eth_eskender_dies: News has come: the young King Eskender was killed on campaign. His brother Na'od has become king.
news.n_eth_vasco: The coastal merchants are uneasy: Portuguese ships have sailed up the African coast, called at Malindi and reached India.
news.n_eth_vasco_again: They say the Portuguese have come back to the Indian Ocean and are sinking Muslim ships.
news.n_eth_kilwa: Merchants from the south say the Portuguese have sacked Kilwa and Mombasa.
news.n_eth_socotra: They say the Portuguese have occupied the island of Socotra at the mouth of the Red Sea.
news.n_eth_naod_dies: News has come: King Na'od is dead. His son Lebna Dengel, still a boy, has become king.
news.n_eth_goa: Merchants say the Portuguese have taken the Indian city of Goa and made it their capital in the east.
news.n_eth_potken: Monks in Rome, they say, have helped a Frank print the Psalter in Ge'ez - the first book in our language made with iron letters.
news.n_eth_cairo_ottoman: News has come: the Ottoman Turks have taken Cairo. The rule of the Mamluks is over.
news.n_eth_luther: Pilgrims say that among the Franks a monk named Luther is arguing with the pope himself.
news.n_eth_embassy_news: Merchants say a Portuguese embassy to the king has landed at Massawa.
news.n_eth_tenochtitlan: They say that beyond the great western sea the Spanish Franks have found new lands and destroyed a great city there.
news.n_eth_eleni_dies: News has come: old Queen Eleni, wise counsellor to three kings, has died.
news.n_eth_mohacs: Merchants say the Turks have routed the Hungarians, and the Hungarian king drowned in a marsh as he fled.
news.n_eth_saga_zaab: They say the Portuguese embassy has gone home, taking with it the monk Saga Za-Ab as the king's envoy to the Franks.
news.n_eth_shimbra_news: Terrible news: the royal army has been routed by Imam Ahmad at Shimbra Kure.
news.n_eth_libanos_burned: News has come: the imam's troops have burned the monastery of Debre Libanos in Shewa.
news.n_eth_atahualpa: They say that beyond the western sea a handful of Spaniards have seized a vast kingdom and executed its ruler.
news.n_eth_aksum_news: They say the imam's troops have reached Aksum and burned the church of Mary of Zion.
news.n_eth_aden_ottoman: Merchants say the Turks have taken Aden and their fleet sails the Red Sea.
news.n_eth_lebna_dies: News has come: King Lebna Dengel has died a fugitive in the mountain monastery of Debre Damo. His son Galawdewos has become king.
news.n_eth_gama_news: They say four hundred Portuguese with fire weapons have landed on the coast to help the king.
news.n_eth_gama_dies_news: News has come: the Portuguese leader da Gama has been captured by the imam and executed.
news.n_eth_trent: Pilgrims say the Franks have gathered a council at Trent to argue with Luther's followers.
news.n_eth_tasfa_seyon: They say the monk Tasfa Seyon has printed the New Testament in Ge'ez in Rome.
news.n_eth_galawdewos_rebuilds: They say King Galawdewos is rebuilding the burned churches and returning the tabots to them.
news.n_eth_mesle: They say that in the south a new generation of Oromo warriors has begun a great march north.
news.n_eth_confessio: They say King Galawdewos has written a "Confession of Faith" to answer the Portuguese priests who criticise our church.
news.n_eth_massawa_news: They say the Turks have taken Massawa and cut off the road to the sea.
news.n_eth_oviedo: They say a Latin bishop, Andrés de Oviedo, has come to Tigray and lives among the Portuguese.
news.n_eth_galawdewos_news: News has come: King Galawdewos has fallen in battle with Emir Nur. His brother Minas, once a captive of the imam, has become king.
news.n_eth_sarsa_king: News has come: King Minas is dead. His son Sarsa Dengel, still very young, has been proclaimed king.
news.n_eth_malta: Merchants say the Turks besieged the island of Malta, but the knight-monks held out.
news.n_eth_nur_dies: They say Emir Nur, who built the city wall, has died in Harar.
news.n_eth_lepanto: News has come: a Frankish fleet has destroyed the Turkish fleet at Lepanto.
news.n_eth_tunis: Merchants say the Turks have finally taken Tunis.
news.n_eth_aussa: They say the imam of Adal has left Harar and moved his capital to the distant oasis of Aussa - further from the Oromo.
news.n_eth_sarsa_victory: News has come: King Sarsa Dengel has defeated the Turks in the north.
news.n_eth_iberian: Merchants say Portugal is now ruled by the king of Spain.
news.n_eth_calendar: Pilgrims say the pope has ordered the Franks to drop ten days from the calendar.
news.n_eth_semien_war: They say King Sarsa Dengel is leading his troops against the rebellious Semien mountains.
news.n_eth_armada: They say a huge Spanish fleet has been destroyed off the English coast - by storms and cannon.
news.n_eth_paez_captive: Merchants from Yemen say the Turks have seized two Frankish monks who were trying to reach our king.
news.n_eth_jesuit_seminary: They say the Portuguese living in Tigray marry local women and teach their children their faith.
news.n_eth_sarsa_dies: News has come: King Sarsa Dengel is dead. A struggle for the throne is beginning at court.
news.n_eth_east_india: Merchants on the coast say new Franks have appeared in the Indian Ocean - the English, and after them the Dutch.
news.n_eth_paez_arrives: They say a learned Frankish monk, Pedro Páez, has secretly made his way into the country.
news.n_eth_za_dengel: News has come: the young King Za Dengel, who leaned towards the Roman faith, has been killed fighting rebels.
news.n_eth_susenyos_king: News has come: after long turmoil, Susenyos has become king.
news.n_eth_oromo_raids: They say King Susenyos is forever campaigning against the Oromo - though he grew up among them as a captive.
news.n_eth_gorgora: They say the Frankish monk is building the king a stone palace on Lake Tana such as has never been seen here.
news.n_eth_nile_source: They say the Frankish monk Páez has reached the very source of the Abay and drunk from it.
news.n_eth_thirty_years: Merchants say the Franks have been slaughtering each other for years in a great war over faith.
news.n_eth_susenyos_news: They say King Susenyos has openly accepted the faith of the Franks.
news.n_eth_paez_dies: News has come: the monk Páez, the king's teacher, has died.
news.n_eth_mendes: They say the Latin patriarch Mendes has arrived in the country with new Frankish monks.
news.n_eth_rebellions: They say rebellions against the Roman faith are breaking out across the land, and the royal troops cannot keep up.
news.n_eth_susenyos_dies: News has come: King Susenyos has abdicated and soon died. His son Fasilides has become king.
news.n_eth_jesuits_out: They say all the Jesuits have been expelled from the country, and Patriarch Mendes has left.
news.n_eth_gondar_news: They say the king is building a permanent capital, Gondar, by Lake Tana.
news.n_eth_capuchins: They say two Frankish monks who entered the country secretly have been executed in Gondar.
news.n_eth_dutch_malacca: Merchants on the coast say the Dutch have taken Malacca from the Portuguese.
news.n_eth_ming_falls: Far to the east, the merchants say, the Chinese realm of the Ming has fallen.
news.n_eth_harar_emir_news: They say a new emir, Ali ibn Daud, rules in Harar.
news.n_eth_yemen_embassy: They say an embassy from the Zaydi imam of Yemen has come to King Fasilides - a friend in hostility to the Franks.
news.n_eth_cape_town: Merchants say the Dutch have founded a settlement at the very southern tip of Africa.
news.n_eth_fasil_castle: They say a stone castle of several storeys, with towers and balconies, has risen in Gondar for the king.
news.n_eth_oman_rising: Merchants on the coast say the Arabs of Oman are driving back the Portuguese at sea.
news.n_eth_council_gondar: They say theologians in Gondar are arguing about the nature of Christ, and the king is calling councils.
news.n_eth_plague_london: Pilgrims say a plague is raging in the great English city of London.
news.n_eth_fasilides_dies: News has come: King Fasilides is dead. His son Yohannes has become king.
news.n_eth_crete: Merchants say the Turks have taken Crete from the Venetians after a twenty-year siege.
news.n_eth_yohannes_laws: They say King Yohannes has ordered Muslims and Franks in Gondar to live apart from the Christians.
news.n_eth_mombasa: Merchants from the south say the Omanis are pressing the Portuguese ever harder around Mombasa.
news.n_eth_iyasu: News has come: King Yohannes is dead. His son Iyasu has become king.
news.n_eth_vienna: They say a huge Turkish army stood before Vienna but was routed.
news.n_eth_iyasu_campaign: They say the young King Iyasu leads his armies south and into the mountains himself.
news.n_eth_bombay: Merchants say the English trade at Surat and Bombay and quarrel with the Dutch.
news.n_eth_iyasu_church: They say King Iyasu is building new churches in Gondar and having them painted.
news.n_eth_poncet: They say a Frankish physician has come to Gondar to treat King Iyasu.
